text:
Aisha: Quick follow-up from the billing postmortem. We still need clear owners and timelines for the delayed-usage / token-count discrepancy that hit invoices last week. I put a short list of action items below — please claim owners.

Connor: I can take token reconciliation. Will write the reconciliation SQL and a reproducible query that maps raw ingestion events -> billed tokens. ETA: EOD today. I'll post the query here.

Connor: SQL draft:
```
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) AS billed_tokens, count(*) AS events
FROM metering.raw_events
WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-08' AND '2026-03-14'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

Priya: I'll own the invoice corrections and crediting run. Need the list of impacted accounts from Connor + a proposed credit amount rubric. Plan: manual credits this week, automated correction next quarter.

Devon: I'll add a dashboard for ingestion lag and an alert (ingestion_delay > 5m) and an on-call playbook. Will aim to have an initial dashboard + alert in 48h. Also recommend a weekly metering health check — I'll create a recurring ticket.

Liam: CS will prepare customer comms templates. Priya, ping me when you have the account list and proposed amounts.

Aisha: Thanks. Two additional asks: (1) an owner for invoice audit (to confirm credits applied), (2) identify if this is part of a recurring pattern (Connor/Devon to check last 6 months). Can we have owners + ETAs by EOD?

Connor: Confirmed owner for reconciliation. I'll include a hash of the query results and a sample account to validate.

Devon: I can take the audit owner role for verification of credits (post-credit sanity checks). ETA for verification run: 3 business days after credits apply.

metering-bot: automated alert summary: ingestion_delay spike on 2026-03-15 02:12 UTC (peak 18m), correlated with backlog on queue 'ingest-1'. See logs: https://internal.redwood/ingest/logs/ingest-1/2026-03-15

Priya: Plan for credits: draft spreadsheet template (columns: account_id, billed_tokens_before, billed_tokens_after, credit_amount, ticket_id). I'll share once Connor's list is in.

Aisha: Perfect. Action owners recap:
- Connor: token reconciliation SQL + impacted list — EOD today
- Priya: invoice credits run plan + spreadsheet — tomorrow
- Devon: dashboard + alert + audit owner — 48h / verification 3 business days post-credit
- Liam: CS comms templates — wait for Priya

Aisha: I'll follow up in #all-hands to get exec visibility once credits plan is ready. Please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
